meta.actor: Claude — consolidation pass (no research, no content rewriting)
meta.scope: Every Grok batch file for India merged into one file. Records are byte-faithful to the batches except for the normalisations listed in _consolidation.

reports.title: The Collection of Statistics Act, 2008
reports.publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation / Parliament of India
reports.description: Principal legislation facilitating the collection of statistics on economic, demographic, social, scientific and environmental aspects. Empowers appropriate governments (Central, State, UT, local) to direct statistical surveys, appoint statistics officers, and impose duties on informants. Repealed the Collection of Statistics Act, 1953. Enforced from 11 June 2010. Rules under the Act include the Collection of Statistics Rules, 2011 (superseded) and Collection of Statistics Rules, 2024.

reports.title: The Census Act, 1948
reports.publisher: Ministry of Home Affairs / Parliament of India
reports.description: Legal framework providing for the taking of the population census in India. Empowers the Central Government to take the census, appoint census staff, and imposes obligations on the public and local authorities. Census is Entry 69 of the Union List. Rules framed under the Act include the Census Rules, 1990 (as amended).

reports.title: National Accounts Statistics
reports.publisher: National Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
reports.description: Annual comprehensive publication presenting detailed estimates of Gross Domestic Product (GDP), Gross Value Added (GVA), consumption, savings, capital formation and related macroeconomic aggregates at current and constant prices. Aligned with the United Nations System of National Accounts (SNA). Includes sectoral breakdowns, institutional sector accounts and time series. The 2025 edition covers Final Estimates for FY 2022-23 and First Revised Estimates for FY 2023-24 (2011-12 series at the time of that release). Base-year revision to 2022-23 underway with new series release targeted for early 2026.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI)
reports.publisher: National Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
reports.description: Monthly Consumer Price Index measuring changes over time in the general level of prices of goods and services acquired by households for consumption. Released for Rural, Urban and Combined sectors at All-India and State/UT levels. Current series base year 2024=100 (revised using Household Consumption Expenditure Survey 2023-24 weights and basket). Used as the primary measure of retail inflation, for inflation targeting, and as a deflator in national accounts.

reports.title: Index of Industrial Production (IIP)
reports.publisher: National Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
reports.description: Monthly index measuring changes in the volume of production in the industrial sector. New series with base year 2022-23 launched June 2026 expands coverage beyond Mining, Manufacturing and Electricity to include Gas Supply, Water Supply, Sewerage and Waste Management; adopts NIC-2025 classification and Output PPI as deflator (replacing earlier WPI-based series). Quick Estimates released approximately 28 days after the reference month. Key high-frequency input into quarterly GDP estimation.

reports.title: Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS)
reports.publisher: National Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
reports.description: Primary source of data on employment and unemployment in India. Launched in 2017. Provides estimates of Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR), Worker Population Ratio (WPR) and Unemployment Rate (UR) under both Usual Status (ps+ss) and Current Weekly Status (CWS). From January 2025 the sampling design was modified to generate monthly and quarterly estimates for both rural and urban areas under CWS, in addition to the annual report. Annual Reports and Monthly/Quarterly Bulletins are released regularly.

reports.title: Household Consumption Expenditure Survey (HCES)
reports.publisher: National Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
reports.description: Large-scale household survey collecting information on consumption of goods and services. Generates estimates of Monthly Per Capita Consumption Expenditure (MPCE) and its distribution for rural and urban sectors, States/UTs and socio-economic groups. Two consecutive surveys conducted post-COVID: HCES 2022-23 (August 2022–July 2023) and HCES 2023-24 (August 2023–July 2024). Results used for poverty analysis, CPI weighting, and national accounts consumption estimates. Fact sheets and detailed reports released by MoSPI; unit-level data disseminated via microdata portal.

reports.title: Census of India
reports.publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (Ministry of Home Affairs)
reports.description: Decennial population and housing census providing the most comprehensive demographic, social and economic profile of the population. Conducted under the Census Act, 1948. Last completed census was 2011. Census 2021 postponed; Census 2027 announced and under preparation (Houselisting Operations scheduled 2026, Population Enumeration to follow). Primary source for population totals, literacy, workforce, housing and many derived indicators used across the statistical system.

reports.title: India’s Balance of Payments
reports.publisher: Reserve Bank of India
reports.description: Quarterly (and monthly preliminary) statistics on India’s Balance of Payments compiled in accordance with the IMF Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6). Covers current account (merchandise, services, primary and secondary income) and capital/financial account (FDI, portfolio investment, external commercial borrowings, banking capital, etc.). Overall balance and reserve movements also published. Key source for external sector analysis and input into national accounts external transactions.

reports.title: Sample Registration System (SRS) Statistical Report
reports.publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
reports.description: Annual statistical report from the Sample Registration System providing continuous fertility and mortality statistics (birth rates, death rates, infant mortality rate, etc.) based on a dual-record system in a nationally representative sample of villages and urban blocks. Complements the decennial Census and Civil Registration System.

reports.title: Annual Survey of Industries (ASI)
reports.publisher: National Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
reports.description: Principal source of industrial statistics covering the organised manufacturing sector (factories registered under the Factories Act). Provides data on output, input, employment, capital formation, value added and related indicators. Conducted annually; results feed into National Accounts and IIP weighting/validation.

_variants.description: Principal source of organised-sector industrial statistics covering factories registered under the Factories Act. Provides detailed data on output, input, employment, fixed capital, value added and related indicators by industry. Results feed National Accounts manufacturing estimates and IIP validation. Unit-level data and summary results released annually.

reports.title: District Social and Economic Review – Nagpur
reports.publisher: District Statistical Office / Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Maharashtra
reports.description: Annual District Social and Economic Review (जिल्हा सामाजिक व आर्थिक समालोचन) for Nagpur district, part of the statewide Maharashtra DES series. Provides multi-domain socio-economic indicators for the largest city and commercial hub of Vidarbha / eastern Maharashtra.

reports.title: Jaipur District Domestic Product / District Statistical Coverage
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics & Statistics, Government of Rajasthan
reports.description: Jaipur district coverage within Rajasthan’s official District Domestic Product series and related DES publications. Jaipur is the state capital and largest urban agglomeration; DDP and district tables form the primary recurring quantitative product.

reports.title: Lucknow District Statistical Coverage
reports.publisher: Economics and Statistics Division, State Planning Institute, Government of Uttar Pradesh
reports.description: Lucknow district indicators embedded in the Uttar Pradesh Statistical Diary and related DES products. As the state capital, Lucknow receives detailed treatment in state-level compilations; dedicated district tables provide the municipal-level statistical layer.

reports.title: Kanpur Nagar District Statistical Coverage
reports.publisher: Economics and Statistics Division, State Planning Institute, Government of Uttar Pradesh / Census of India
reports.description: Kanpur Nagar district coverage within UP Statistical Diary and District Census Handbooks. Kanpur remains one of the largest industrial cities of northern India; district-level statistics are the principal official recurring product.

reports.title: Indore District Statistical Coverage
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics & Statistics, Government of Madhya Pradesh
reports.description: Indore district indicators within Madhya Pradesh DES publications and District Domestic Product series. Indore is the largest city and commercial capital of Madhya Pradesh; state Economic Survey and DDP provide the main statistical layer.

reports.title: Bhopal District Statistical Coverage
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics & Statistics, Government of Madhya Pradesh
reports.description: Bhopal district coverage (state capital) within Madhya Pradesh DES Economic Survey, District Domestic Product estimates and related statistical products.

reports.title: Maharashtra District Social and Economic Review Series (system)
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Maharashtra
reports.description: Statewide system of annual District Social and Economic Reviews (जिल्हा सामाजिक व आर्थिक समालोचन) produced for every district of Maharashtra. Already individualised for Mumbai City, Mumbai Suburban, Pune and Nagpur; this node captures the existence of the full series as a structured municipal-layer statistical product of the state DES.

reports.title: Energy Statistics India
reports.publisher: National Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
reports.description: Annual integrated publication presenting data on reserves, capacity, production, consumption, trade and energy balances for coal, lignite, petroleum, natural gas, electricity and renewable sources. Includes Total Primary Energy Supply (TPES), energy accounts aligned with SEEA-Energy, physical supply and use tables, and sustainable energy indicators. Latest editions: Energy Statistics India 2025 and 2026.

reports.title: EnviStats India: Environment Statistics
reports.publisher: National Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
reports.description: Annual (or near-annual) compilation of environment statistics organised according to the Framework for the Development of Environment Statistics (FDES) 2013. Covers six components: Environmental Conditions and Quality; Environmental Resources and their Use; Residuals; Extreme Events and Disasters; Human Settlements and Environmental Health; Environmental Protection, Management and Engagement. Parallel Environment Accounts issues follow SEEA. 8th issue released 2025.

reports.title: Women and Men in India: Selected Indicators and Data
reports.publisher: National Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
reports.description: Long-running annual gender statistics compendium consolidating indicators on population, health, education, participation in the economy, decision-making, violence against women and SDG-gender linkages. 27th edition (2025) released April 2026. Draws on Census, SRS, PLFS, education and health administrative data.

reports.title: Agricultural Statistics at a Glance
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
reports.description: Flagship annual statistical publication of the Ministry of Agriculture providing comprehensive data on area, production and yield of major crops, land-use classification, irrigation, agricultural inputs, livestock, fisheries, prices, trade and related indicators. Latest available editions cover 2023 and 2024-25.

reports.title: Land Use Statistics at a Glance
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
reports.description: Annual compilation of the nine-fold land-use classification, source-wise and crop-wise irrigated area, and area under crops. Provides the official national and state-level series used for agricultural planning and as an input into national accounts for the primary sector.

reports.title: Annual Survey of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises (ASUSE)
reports.publisher: National Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
reports.description: Annual survey of unincorporated non-agricultural establishments in manufacturing, trade and other services (excluding construction). Estimates number of establishments, employment, emoluments, GVA and digital adoption. Launched 2021-22; subsequent rounds 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2025 (calendar-year reference). Quarterly bulletins (QBUSE) also issued from 2025. Critical input for informal-sector contribution to National Accounts.

reports.title: National Health Profile
reports.publisher: Central Bureau of Health Intelligence, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
reports.description: Annual comprehensive compilation of health statistics covering demography, socio-economic status, disease morbidity and mortality, healthcare finance, human resources and health infrastructure. Produced by CBHI; provides time-series data used for health planning and monitoring.

reports.title: Household Social Consumption: Health (NSS)
reports.publisher: National Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
reports.description: Periodic large-scale household survey module on health under the National Sample Survey. Most recent full survey conducted January–December 2025 (80th round). Covers morbidity, hospitalisation, maternity care, health insurance coverage, expenditure on healthcare and related indicators. Complements the National Health Profile and feeds into health-sector analysis and National Accounts.

reports.title: Statistical Report on Value of Output from Agriculture and Allied Sectors
reports.publisher: National Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
reports.description: Annual detailed publication providing estimates of Gross Value of Output and Gross Value Added for crops, livestock, forestry & logging and fishing & aquaculture at current and constant prices. Complements the headline National Accounts aggregates for the primary sector with finer commodity-level detail.

reports.title: Economic Survey of Maharashtra
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Planning Department, Government of Maharashtra
reports.description: Annual flagship publication presenting the state of the Maharashtra economy, including GSDP estimates, sectoral performance (agriculture, industry, services), prices, public finance, social sector indicators and district-level comparisons. Latest editions cover 2024-25 and 2025-26. Primary source for state-level macroeconomic analysis and input into national compilations.

reports.title: Statistical Diary Uttar Pradesh
reports.publisher: Economics and Statistics Division, State Planning Institute, Planning Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
reports.description: Long-running annual statistical compendium (published since 1968) containing ~150 tables covering population, agriculture, animal husbandry, industry, employment, public health, education, state income, revenue and expenditure, and social services. Provides time-series and district-level data for the most populous state.

reports.title: Statistical Handbook of Tamil Nadu
reports.publisher: Department of Economics and Statistics, Government of Tamil Nadu
reports.description: Annual comprehensive statistical handbook covering area and population, vital statistics, climate, agriculture, irrigation, animal husbandry, fisheries, forests, electricity, industries, factories, medical and health, education, employment, housing, transport, prices, state income and finance. Also issues district and municipal handbooks.

reports.title: Karnataka at a Glance
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Karnataka
reports.description: Annual statistical digest presenting key socio-economic indicators for the state and districts. Complements the more detailed Statistical Abstract and Economic Survey series. Regularly updated with GSDP, district domestic product, prices, industrial production and social indicators.

reports.title: Economic Survey of Karnataka
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics / Planning Department, Government of Karnataka
reports.description: Annual economic survey providing analysis of state economic performance, GSDP and district domestic product estimates, sectoral trends, infrastructure, social development and policy review. Latest editions include 2023-24 and 2025-26.

reports.title: Socio-Economic Review Gujarat State
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Gujarat
reports.description: Annual budget-linked publication (Budget Publication series) reviewing the socio-economic performance of Gujarat. Covers state and Indian economy overview, population, agriculture, industries, infrastructure, social sectors, prices and public finance, with extensive statistical statements.

reports.title: Statistical Handbook West Bengal
reports.publisher: Bureau of Applied Economics & Statistics, Department of Statistics & Programme Implementation, Government of West Bengal
reports.description: Recurring statistical handbook presenting salient socio-economic features of West Bengal, including area and population, agriculture, industry, infrastructure, social services and other domains. Updated time-series from state and central sources.

reports.title: Bihar Statistical Hand Book
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Department of Planning and Development, Government of Bihar
reports.description: Comprehensive statistical handbook of Bihar covering multi-sectoral data. Complements the lighter ‘Bihar at a Glance’ and ‘Bihar Through Figures’ series. Serves as the principal detailed statistical reference for the lower-income contrast state.

reports.title: Bihar Economic Survey
reports.publisher: Finance Department / Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Bihar
reports.description: Annual economic survey analysing Bihar’s GSDP growth, sectoral composition, public investment, infrastructure and human development. Recent editions (including 2025-26) highlight growth rates frequently above the national average and rising capital formation.

reports.title: Bihar at a Glance
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Bihar
reports.description: Concise annual statistical digest providing key indicators on population, economy, agriculture, social sector and infrastructure for Bihar. Complements the fuller Statistical Hand Book.

reports.title: Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) series (selected major states)
reports.publisher: Respective State Directorates of Economics and Statistics (coordinated with MoSPI)
reports.description: Official annual (and advance/revised) estimates of Gross State Domestic Product and Net State Domestic Product at current and constant prices, compiled by State DES following MoSPI guidelines and SNA concepts. Forms the core regional accounts layer that feeds into national GDP compilation and inter-state comparisons. Covered here for Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Gujarat, West Bengal and Bihar.

reports.title: Delhi Statistical Hand Book
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics & Statistics, Government of NCT of Delhi
reports.description: Long-running annual statistical handbook (45th+ issue) presenting socio-economic data for the National Capital Territory of Delhi under ~23 broad chapters covering population, vital statistics, agriculture, industry, transport, education, health, prices, public finance and other domains. Primary recurring statistical product for the capital territory.

reports.title: District Social and Economic Review – Mumbai City
reports.publisher: District Statistical Office / Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Maharashtra
reports.description: Annual district-level Social and Economic Review (जिल्हा सामाजिक व आर्थिक समालोचन) prepared by the District Statistical Office, Mumbai City. Contains detailed tables on area, population, agriculture, industry, infrastructure, social sector, district domestic product and other socio-economic indicators specific to Mumbai City district. Part of the statewide district review series.

reports.title: District Social and Economic Review – Mumbai Suburban
reports.publisher: District Statistical Office / Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Maharashtra
reports.description: Annual district-level Social and Economic Review for Mumbai Suburban district, parallel to the Mumbai City volume. Provides the complementary geographic coverage of Greater Mumbai under the Maharashtra DES district series.

reports.title: Handbook of Basic Statistics of Maharashtra
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Maharashtra
reports.description: Concise annual handbook presenting up-to-date statistical data on socio-economic aspects of the Maharashtra economy in compact form. Complements the fuller Economic Survey and district reviews; useful for quick reference including Greater Mumbai indicators.

reports.title: Kolkata Municipal Corporation – Basic Statistics
reports.publisher: Kolkata Municipal Corporation
reports.description: Official basic statistics maintained and published by Kolkata Municipal Corporation covering geographic area, population, density, climate, infrastructure (roads, sewerage, water supply), solid waste, markets, parks, schools and other municipal indicators. Updated on the KMC portal.

reports.title: District Domestic Product (selected major city districts)
reports.publisher: Respective State Directorates of Economics and Statistics
reports.description: Official estimates of Gross / Net District Domestic Product compiled by State DES for major urban districts (including Mumbai City, Mumbai Suburban, Bengaluru Urban, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad and Delhi). Forms the primary quantitative link between city-level economic activity and state GSDP / national accounts.

reports.title: Statistical Abstract Andhra Pradesh
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Andhra Pradesh
reports.description: Recurring statistical abstract and related publications (District at a Glance, GSDP estimates) from the nodal DES of Andhra Pradesh. Covers multi-sectoral socio-economic data and state income series.

reports.title: Socio Economic Outlook / Statistical Year Book Telangana
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics / Planning Department, Government of Telangana
reports.description: Annual Socio-Economic Outlook and Statistical Year Book / Telangana at a Glance series presenting GSDP, sectoral performance, prices, social indicators and atlas-style compilations for the state created in 2014.

reports.title: Economic Review Rajasthan
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics & Statistics, Statistics Department, Government of Rajasthan
reports.description: Annual Economic Review analysing Rajasthan’s GSDP growth, sectoral composition (agriculture, industry, services), infrastructure, human development and policy priorities. Latest editions cover 2023-24 and 2025-26.

reports.title: Madhya Pradesh Economic Survey
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics & Statistics, Government of Madhya Pradesh
reports.description: Annual Economic Survey presenting GSDP estimates, sectoral analysis (strong primary-sector weight), social inclusion, infrastructure and development indicators for Madhya Pradesh. Recent editions project robust nominal growth.

reports.title: Odisha Economic Survey
reports.publisher: Planning & Convergence Department / Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Odisha
reports.description: Annual Economic Survey with full statistical appendix covering GSDP, sectoral performance, social sector, infrastructure and district-level indicators. Strong series maintained through 2025-26.

reports.title: UDISE+ (Unified District Information System for Education Plus)
reports.publisher: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education
reports.description: Largest management information system for school education in India. Annual real-time collection of data from ~1.5 million recognised schools covering infrastructure, teachers, student enrolment, facilities and related indicators from pre-primary to higher secondary. Official statistics of the Ministry of Education for school education.

reports.title: All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE)
reports.publisher: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
reports.description: Annual web-based survey covering all institutions imparting higher education in India. Collects data on teachers, student enrolment, programmes, examination results, finance and infrastructure. Produces key indicators including Gross Enrolment Ratio, Gender Parity Index and pupil-teacher ratio. Reports released for 2022-23 and 2023-24.

reports.title: India Tourism Statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Government of India
reports.description: Annual flagship statistical publication of the Ministry of Tourism providing detailed data on international and domestic tourist arrivals, foreign exchange earnings, classified hotels, state-wise tourism performance and related indicators. Accompanied by the shorter ‘Tourism Statistics at a Glance’ and Data Compendium series.

reports.title: Odisha District at a Glance
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Odisha
reports.description: Annual district-level statistical digest complementary to the Odisha Economic Survey, providing key indicators across districts.

reports.title: Economic Review Kerala
reports.publisher: Kerala State Planning Board / Department of Economics & Statistics, Government of Kerala
reports.description: Annual Economic Review presenting GSDP estimates, sectoral performance, social development indicators and policy analysis for Kerala. Supported by a rich DES data portal with time-series on state income, agriculture, vital statistics and prices.

reports.title: Statistical Abstract / Punjab Development Statistics
reports.publisher: Bureau of Statistics / Economic & Statistical Organisation, Government of Punjab
reports.description: Long-running annual Statistical Abstract and Punjab Development Statistics series covering multi-sectoral socio-economic data, state income, agriculture, industry, social sector and comparative indicators. Also issues Economic Survey and Punjab at a Glance.

reports.title: State Statistical Abstract of Haryana
reports.publisher: Department of Economic and Statistical Affairs, Government of Haryana
reports.description: Annual State Statistical Abstract presenting comprehensive socio-economic statistics for Haryana. Accompanied by the annual Economic Survey of Haryana (budget document) and district statistical abstracts.

reports.title: Economic Survey of Haryana
reports.publisher: Department of Economic and Statistical Affairs, Government of Haryana
reports.description: Annual budget-linked Economic Survey reviewing state economy performance across primary, secondary and tertiary sectors, prices, public distribution, welfare schemes and state finances.

reports.title: Statistical Handbook Assam
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Assam
reports.description: Long-running annual Statistical Handbook (57th edition in 2025) providing comprehensive multi-sectoral socio-economic data for Assam. Principal detailed statistical reference for the North-Eastern region; complemented by the annual Economic Survey Assam.

reports.title: Economic Survey Assam
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics / Transformation & Development Department, Government of Assam
reports.description: Annual Economic Survey analysing Assam’s GSDP, sectoral trends, social development and fiscal position. Provides the analytical counterpart to the Statistical Handbook.

reports.title: Wholesale Price Index (WPI)
reports.publisher: Office of the Economic Adviser, Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
reports.description: Monthly Wholesale Price Index measuring changes in prices of commodities at the wholesale level. New series with base year 2022-23 released June 2026 (replacing 2011-12 series); expanded item basket (957 items) and inclusion of new & renewable energy under Electricity. Accompanied by Output PPI and experimental Input/Service PPIs. Key high-frequency price indicator used in policy and as a deflator.

reports.title: Indian Railways Year Book / Annual Statistical Statements
reports.publisher: Directorate of Statistics and Economics, Ministry of Railways (Railway Board)
reports.description: Annual suite of official statistical publications of Indian Railways: Year Book, Annual Report & Accounts, Annual Statistical Statements and Statistical Summary Sheet. Provide comprehensive data on traffic (passenger and freight), rolling stock, track, financial performance, personnel and operational efficiency indicators.

reports.title: Ministry of Defence Annual Report
reports.publisher: Ministry of Defence, Government of India
reports.description: Annual official report of the Ministry of Defence covering defence policy, organisational structure, force readiness, modernisation, defence production, research & development (DRDO), international defence cooperation, and related budgetary and administrative matters. Long-running series with editions through 2024-25.

reports.title: Ministry of External Affairs Annual Report
reports.publisher: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India
reports.description: Annual official report of the Ministry of External Affairs documenting India’s bilateral, regional and multilateral diplomacy. Contains dedicated chapters on neighbourhood policy, BIMSTEC, SAARC, IORA, ASEAN, Indo-Pacific frameworks, BRICS engagement and other regional partnerships. Primary official narrative source for India’s regional and BRICS diplomacy.

reports.title: BRICS Joint Statistical Publication (India contribution / host editions)
reports.publisher: National Statistical Office (India) in collaboration with BRICS National Statistical Offices
reports.description: Annual joint statistical publication of the BRICS national statistical offices. India has hosted/compiled editions (notably 2021) and contributes national data series on population, national accounts, prices, labour, living standards and other socio-economic indicators. Complements the broader BRICS international statistical layer already captured.

reports.title: New Development Bank – India Country Portfolio / Fact Sheet
reports.publisher: New Development Bank (NDB)
reports.description: Periodic official fact sheets and portfolio updates issued by the New Development Bank detailing approved projects, financing volumes and sectoral distribution in India. As of early 2026, 32 projects approved with approximately USD 9.5 billion in financing. Provides the quantitative India-side record of the principal BRICS financial institution.

reports.title: Bengaluru Urban District Statistical Report
reports.publisher: District Administration / Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Karnataka (Bengaluru Urban)
reports.description: District-level statistical reports issued for Bengaluru Urban covering socio-economic indicators. Complements the statewide Karnataka at a Glance / Economic Survey series with city-district granularity. (Note: dedicated annual municipal handbook of Delhi density not located; district reports and state publications remain the primary official sources.)

reports.title: Chennai District Statistical / Census Handbook products
reports.publisher: Department of Economics and Statistics, Tamil Nadu / Census of India
reports.description: Chennai district coverage within the Tamil Nadu Statistical Handbook series and District Census Handbooks. Greater Chennai Corporation maintains operational statistics; the primary recurring multi-domain statistical product remains the state handbook with district tables.

reports.title: Hyderabad / GHMC District Statistical Coverage
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Telangana / Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation
reports.description: Hyderabad (including GHMC) is covered through Telangana DES publications (Socio-Economic Outlook, Statistical Year Book, district domestic product) and district-level tables. GHMC operational data exist; the principal multi-domain recurring statistical product is the state series with urban-district breakouts.

reports.title: Defence Services Estimates / Union Budget – Defence
reports.publisher: Ministry of Defence / Ministry of Finance (Budget Division)
reports.description: Annual Defence Services Estimates and the defence demand of the Union Budget providing the official quantitative presentation of defence expenditure (revenue and capital), pensions, and MoD (Civil) outlays. Forms the primary public statistical record of India’s defence budget.

reports.title: Jharkhand Economic Survey
reports.publisher: Department of Finance / Centre for Fiscal Studies, Department of Planning and Development, Government of Jharkhand
reports.description: Annual Economic Survey presenting GSDP estimates, sectoral performance (strong mineral and primary-sector weight), fiscal developments, social indicators and poverty trends for Jharkhand. Recent editions cover 2023-24 through 2025-26.

reports.title: Chhattisgarh Economic Survey
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics & Statistics, Government of Chhattisgarh
reports.description: Annual Economic Survey reviewing state income, sectoral performance, prices, public finance, agriculture, minerals, industry, social services and SDGs. Supported by the parallel Statistical Abstract and Chhattisgarh at a Glance series.

reports.title: Chhattisgarh Statistical Abstract
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics & Statistics, Government of Chhattisgarh
reports.description: Annual multi-domain Statistical Abstract providing detailed tables across socio-economic sectors for Chhattisgarh. Complements the Economic Survey.

reports.title: Himachal Pradesh Economic Survey
reports.publisher: Economics and Statistics Department, Government of Himachal Pradesh
reports.description: Annual Economic Survey tabled in the State Legislature during the budget session. Covers GSDP, sectoral performance, social development and policy challenges for the hill state. Latest editions include 2023-24 and 2025-26.

reports.title: Uttarakhand At A Glance / Economic Survey
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Uttarakhand
reports.description: Annual ‘Uttarakhand At A Glance’ statistical digest and related Economic Survey products presenting key socio-economic indicators, GSDP and development trends for the state.

reports.title: Crime in India
reports.publisher: National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB), Ministry of Home Affairs
reports.description: Oldest and principal annual statistical publication of the NCRB (first issue relating to 1953; latest covering 2024). Provides detailed all-India and state-wise data on cognizable crimes under IPC/BNS and Special & Local Laws, crime rates, chargesheeting rates, crimes against women/children, and related indicators. Primary official crime statistics series of India.

reports.title: National Family Health Survey (NFHS)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS)
reports.description: Large-scale multi-round household survey providing estimates of fertility, infant and child mortality, family planning, maternal and child health, nutrition, domestic violence and related indicators at national, state and district levels. NFHS-5 (2019-21) and NFHS-6 (2023-24) are the most recent completed rounds. Principal official source for many health and demographic indicators used across policy and research.

reports.title: District Social and Economic Review – Pune
reports.publisher: District Statistical Office / Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Maharashtra
reports.description: Annual District Social and Economic Review (जिल्हा सामाजिक व आर्थिक समालोचन) for Pune district, part of the statewide Maharashtra DES district series. Provides detailed socio-economic indicators for one of India’s largest and most economically important urban agglomerations outside the Mumbai metro.

reports.title: Ahmedabad District Statistical Coverage
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Gujarat
reports.description: Ahmedabad district coverage within Gujarat DES publications and District Census Handbooks. Key economic and demographic indicators for Gujarat’s largest city are embedded in the state Socio-Economic Review and related statistical products.

reports.title: Surat District Statistical Coverage
reports.publisher: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Gujarat
reports.description: Surat district indicators (demography, industry, infrastructure, health, vehicles, banking) maintained and published by Gujarat DES. Surat is one of India’s fastest-growing industrial and diamond-trade cities; statistics appear in state and district-level products.

reports.title: All India Electricity Statistics – General Review
reports.publisher: Central Electricity Authority (CEA), Ministry of Power
reports.description: Annual flagship statistical publication of the Central Electricity Authority presenting comprehensive data on installed capacity, generation, transmission, distribution, utilisation, per-capita consumption and related electricity-sector indicators for All-India and states. Primary official electricity statistics series.

reports.title: Power Supply Position Reports (CEA)
reports.publisher: Central Electricity Authority (CEA), Ministry of Power
reports.description: Monthly Power Supply Position reports (Energy and Peak) issued by CEA providing high-frequency operational statistics on electricity supply, demand, shortages and related indicators across the country.

dependencies.basis: Index of Industrial Production is a key high-frequency volume indicator used in the estimation of quarterly and annual Gross Value Added for the manufacturing and related industrial sectors in the National Accounts.
Consumer Price Index series serve as deflators and are used in the compilation of constant-price estimates and private final consumption expenditure in the National Accounts.

Household Consumption Expenditure Survey results provide the expenditure weights and item basket used for the comprehensive revision of the CPI series (most recently the 2024=100 series based on HCES 2023-24).
HCES data on household consumption expenditure are a primary input into the estimation of Private Final Consumption Expenditure in the National Accounts.

RBI Balance of Payments statistics supply the external transactions data (exports, imports, primary and secondary income) incorporated into the National Accounts sequence of accounts and external sector aggregates.
PLFS sampling design uses the Census frame (villages and Urban Frame Survey blocks) as the primary sampling units for the selection of First Stage Units.
HCES sample allocation and First Stage Unit selection are based on the Census population frame and Urban Frame Survey.
The Collection of Statistics Act, 2008 provides the legal authority under which directions for the collection of industrial statistics (including the Annual Survey of Industries) are issued.
The Census of India is conducted under the legal authority and procedural framework established by the Census Act, 1948 and the rules made thereunder.
Nagpur District Social and Economic Review feeds district-level indicators into the statewide Maharashtra Economic Survey.
Jaipur District Domestic Product and related district tables feed into the Rajasthan Economic Review.
Lucknow district indicators are published within the Uttar Pradesh Statistical Diary.
Kanpur Nagar district statistics appear in the UP Statistical Diary and related DES products.
Indore district coverage is incorporated in the Madhya Pradesh Economic Survey and DDP series.
Bhopal district indicators feed into the Madhya Pradesh Economic Survey.
Additional urban-district DDP estimates continue to aggregate into state GSDP.
Annual Survey of Industries is a principal data source for estimating Gross Value Added and related aggregates of the organised manufacturing sector in the National Accounts.
ASUSE provides the key estimates of the unincorporated (informal) non-agricultural sector that are incorporated into National Accounts estimates of manufacturing, trade and services GVA.
Land Use Statistics form a core component of the broader Agricultural Statistics at a Glance compilation, supplying the official nine-fold classification and irrigated-area series.
Crop area, production and related agricultural statistics compiled by DES are primary inputs into the estimation of Gross Value of Output and GVA for the agriculture sector in National Accounts.
Energy production, consumption and balance data from Energy Statistics are incorporated into the Environmental Resources and Residuals components of EnviStats.
Labour Force Participation Rate, Worker Population Ratio and related gender-disaggregated labour indicators published in Women and Men in India are drawn from the Periodic Labour Force Survey.
Population, sex-ratio and related demographic indicators in Women and Men in India rely on Census of India data.
Maternal mortality, infant mortality and sex-ratio-at-birth series used in the health chapter of Women and Men in India are sourced from the Sample Registration System.
Economic Survey of Maharashtra presents and analyses the official GSDP estimates produced by the state DES.
Economic Survey of Karnataka is built around the state’s official GSDP and District Domestic Product estimates.
Bihar Economic Survey analyses the official GSDP series released by the state Directorate of Economics and Statistics.
State GSDP estimates compiled by State DES under MoSPI methodological guidance are aggregated and reconciled in the compilation of All-India GDP and related national accounts aggregates.
Statistical Diary Uttar Pradesh includes the official state income / GSDP tables produced by the Economics and Statistics Division.
Statistical Handbook of Tamil Nadu contains the official State Income / GSDP series compiled by the Department of Economics and Statistics.
Socio-Economic Review of Gujarat presents the official GSDP and related state accounts estimates.
Population, literacy and related demographic tables in the Statistical Diary rely on Census of India results.
Area, population and vital-statistics chapters of the Tamil Nadu Statistical Handbook draw on Census and SRS data.
District Social and Economic Review for Mumbai City supplies district-level indicators that feed into and are summarised in the statewide Economic Survey of Maharashtra.
Mumbai Suburban district review contributes the complementary urban data used in the Maharashtra Economic Survey’s treatment of Greater Mumbai.
Delhi Statistical Hand Book presents the official GSDP / NSDP estimates for the National Capital Territory compiled by the Delhi DES.
Population, literacy and demographic chapters of the Delhi Statistical Hand Book rely on Census of India results.
Demographic tables in the Mumbai City District Social and Economic Review are based on Census of India data.
Kolkata Municipal Corporation basic statistics contribute municipal-level indicators that appear in or inform the broader West Bengal Statistical Handbook.
Andhra Pradesh DES Statistical Abstract and related publications present the official GSDP estimates of the state.
Telangana Socio-Economic Outlook and Statistical Year Book are built around the official state domestic product series.
Rajasthan Economic Review analyses the official GSDP estimates compiled by the state DES.
Madhya Pradesh Economic Survey presents and analyses the official GSDP series of the state.
Odisha Economic Survey is structured around the official GSDP and sectoral estimates produced by the state statistical system.
School enrolment, literacy-related and gender-parity indicators in Women and Men in India draw on UDISE+ school education statistics.
Higher-education enrolment and Gender Parity Index figures used in Women and Men in India are sourced from AISHE.
Kerala Economic Review presents and analyses the official GSDP estimates compiled by the state DES.
Punjab Statistical Abstract / Development Statistics include the official state income / GSDP tables.
Economic Survey of Haryana is built around the official GSDP series of the state.
Assam Economic Survey analyses the official GSDP estimates produced by the state DES.
Wholesale Price Index series have historically been used as deflators and price indicators in the compilation of constant-price national accounts aggregates (alongside CPI).
Railway traffic, earnings and related operational statistics feed into the transport and storage component of National Accounts and related sectoral estimates.
Ministry of Defence Annual Report presents and contextualises the expenditure figures contained in the Defence Services Estimates / Union Budget defence demands.
MEA Annual Report documents India’s diplomatic and institutional engagement with BRICS, which is quantitatively supported by the joint statistical work of the national statistical offices.
India’s contribution to the BRICS Joint Statistical Publication draws on official national accounts, demographic and social statistics produced by MoSPI/NSO.
NDB India portfolio and project financing form part of the BRICS institutional cooperation documented in the MEA Annual Report’s multilateral chapters.
Bengaluru Urban district statistical material feeds into and is summarised within the statewide Karnataka Economic Survey and related DES publications.
Chennai district tables are integral components of the Tamil Nadu Statistical Handbook series.
Hyderabad / GHMC indicators appear within Telangana DES Socio-Economic Outlook and Statistical Year Book district-level presentations.
Defence expenditure recorded in the Union Budget / Defence Services Estimates enters the government final consumption and capital formation components of National Accounts.
Jharkhand Economic Survey presents the official GSDP estimates of the state.
Chhattisgarh Economic Survey is structured around the official state domestic product series.
Himachal Pradesh Economic Survey analyses the official GSDP estimates compiled by the state DES.
Uttarakhand At A Glance / Economic Survey products include the official state income series.
Many gender, health, fertility and nutrition indicators published in Women and Men in India draw on NFHS results.
Pune District Social and Economic Review supplies district-level indicators that feed into the statewide Maharashtra Economic Survey.
Ahmedabad district indicators are incorporated in the Gujarat Socio-Economic Review and related DES publications.
Surat district statistics appear within the Gujarat DES state-level statistical products.
Central Electricity Authority electricity statistics are a primary input into MoSPI’s Energy Statistics compilation.
Monthly Power Supply Position data feed into the annual All India Electricity Statistics – General Review.

_dropped.why: National Statistical Commission (NSC) itself is an institutional body established by government resolution (2005/2006) rather than a titled recurring statistical publication or one-off legal instrument with standalone statistical content suitable as a Report node under DATA SPEC v2. Its mandate documents and annual reports can be considered in a later methodological batch if concrete titled outputs with evidence links are identified.

Wholesale Price Index (WPI) is compiled by the Office of the Economic Adviser, Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce & Industry, not MoSPI. It remains relevant as a potential dependency or parallel series but is outside the strict MoSPI/RBI/Census core of this first batch.

Detailed sectoral yearbooks (Energy Statistics, EnviStats, Women and Men in India, etc.), full State Statistical Abstracts, and major-city handbooks are deferred to subsequent batches following the Russia densification sequence (national core → sectoral → states with contrast → cities).

Maharashtra remains the only state with a clean, statewide, annually published District Social and Economic Review series of consistent titled format. Most other states embed district data inside state Statistical Abstracts / Economic Surveys or produce irregular district handbooks; the nodes above reflect the strongest available official products.
Further secondary cities (Coimbatore, Visakhapatnam, Kochi, Chandigarh, Patna, Ranchi, Raipur, etc.) can be elevated if high-value recurring district series are confirmed later.
ASI was already introduced in Batch 1; it is re-listed here with fuller sectoral context and explicit NAS dependency because it is the core organised-industry series. No duplicate node created.

Transport statistics (e.g., Railway Yearbook, Road Transport Year Book, Civil Aviation statistics) and detailed education yearbooks (UDISE+, AISHE) are strong candidates but are deferred to a later densification pass once state-level and city-level batches begin, to keep the present batch focused on the highest-frequency MoSPI/DES core sectoral products.

National Health Profile is compiled by CBHI (MoHFW), not MoSPI. It is included because it is the principal recurring national health statistical publication and is regularly cited alongside NSS health modules.

Additional high-output states (e.g. Andhra Pradesh/Telangana, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh) and further North-Eastern contrast states can be added in a subsequent densification batch once the core set is verified.
District Domestic Product series and city-level handbooks exist for several of these states but are deferred to the municipal/city layer (next phase of the densification sequence).

Some state DES sites host multiple related products (e.g. Karnataka Statistical Abstract alongside ‘at a Glance’). Only the most regularly cited and currently maintained titles are elevated to Report nodes in this batch.

Bengaluru (Bengaluru Urban), Chennai and Hyderabad possess strong district-level data within their respective State DES publications (Karnataka at a Glance / Economic Survey, Tamil Nadu Statistical Handbook, Telangana Statistical Abstract) and District Census Handbooks, but dedicated annual city-only statistical handbooks of the same density as Delhi’s or Mumbai’s district reviews were not located as currently maintained titled series. Vertical ties are captured via the District Domestic Product node and state-level reports already in Batch 3.

Further municipal densification (additional Corporation statistical reports, ward-level series, or city-specific price/employment bulletins) can be added if high-value titled recurring products are identified in a later pass.

District Census Handbooks (Census 2011 and forthcoming 2027) exist for all major cities and remain available as one-off / decennial reference products; they are not elevated as separate recurring Report nodes here.

Further states (e.g. Kerala, Punjab, Haryana, Assam and remaining North-Eastern states) and additional sectoral series (road transport yearbook, railway statistics, civil aviation) remain available for a later densification pass if required.
UDISE+ and AISHE are the principal official statistical systems for school and higher education respectively; both are annual and nationally comprehensive.
Punjab (India) Statistical Abstract / Development Statistics is the correct series; earlier search noise included Pakistan Punjab material which is excluded.

Remaining smaller states/UTs and specialised series (Civil Aviation statistics, Road Transport Year Book, further North-Eastern handbooks) can be added if high-value gaps surface during Claude verification.

WPI is compiled by Office of the Economic Adviser (DPIIT), not MoSPI; included because it is the principal wholesale-price statistical product and a key input/deflator historically linked to national accounts and IIP.

Dedicated annual city statistical handbooks of Delhi/Mumbai density were not located for Bengaluru, Chennai or Hyderabad. Coverage is therefore provided via district statistical reports and the strong state-level series already in earlier batches, with explicit vertical dependencies.

Further specialised defence statistical products (e.g. detailed DRDO annual reports, service-specific yearbooks) and additional regional organisation statistical outputs (BIMSTEC data portal indicators, IORA) can be elevated if high-value titled recurring series are confirmed in verification.

BRICS Joint Statistical Publication is an international product; the India-host/contribution node is retained here to capture the domestic statistical system’s explicit participation in the BRICS statistical cooperation layer.

NFHS is multi-year (roughly every 3–5 years) rather than annual; releases_per_year set to 0.2 to reflect typical frequency while still elevating the series as the principal official health/demographic survey.
Further North-Eastern states and smaller UTs remain available for a later pass if required.

Dedicated annual municipal handbooks of Delhi density remain rare outside a few metros. Pune benefits from the strong Maharashtra district Social & Economic Review series; Ahmedabad and Surat rely on Gujarat DES district/state products.
Further metros (Jaipur, Lucknow, Kanpur, Nagpur, Coimbatore, etc.) and additional sectoral series can be added if still required after verification.

Endpoint(s) in-srs not defined in any consolidated country file or in the live corpus. Original basis: NFHS provides independent estimates of fertility, infant and child mortality that are compared with and complement the Sample Registration System (SRS).

_consolidation.json_syntax_repair_note: These batch files were not valid JSON as delivered: "releases_per_year" carried an unquoted text value (missing opening quote), e.g. `"releases_per_year": continuous",`. Repaired mechanically by re-quoting the value verbatim. No number was invented.
_consolidation.cadence_note: A non-numeric cadence text was moved off releases_per_year into _cadence_original verbatim and the numeric field omitted, per the v2 spec (omitted, never null). Needs a human/judgement pass to become a real number.

_normalisation.note: Second pass, 2026-08-18: mechanical alignment to src/lib/types.ts. Nothing researched, nothing invented. Every original value that was replaced is preserved on the record under a key prefixed with an underscore.
rules: jurisdiction_level mapped into the six-value union; the delivered string kept as _jurisdiction_level_original.
domains: format-normalised, then any tag outside the 22 approved values prefixed "proposed:" as the spec directs. No semantic merging was done — that needs your call.

relationship_type: part_of edges moved onto the child node as part_of; contains edges reversed onto the child; produced_by edges dropped (publisher is a string, not a node); related_to / complements held in _dropped as deferred. Off-union values were poisoning every PageRank score with NaN.
last_updated added as null where absent (required field, string|null).
region filled with the country name where it was null or missing.
releases_per_year: unambiguous single-word cadences resolved to numbers; ambiguous text left in _cadence_original and listed under _gaps.unresolved_cadence.
source_kind mapped to official/commercial; delivered value kept as _source_kind_original.
Non-schema keys Grok wrote (shape, notes, referenced_by, ...) renamed with a leading underscore so they are visibly not part of the schema. Nothing deleted.

_gaps.note: What is genuinely missing and cannot be fixed mechanically — this is the research queue, not a defect list.
_gaps.not_a_publication_note: These 0 nodes were checked against the web and are not published documents — synthesised 'meta'/'framing' nodes that only bind other nodes together, geographic areas, industries, projects, or institutions. The data spec (2b/2c) bans all of these. They are flagged in place with _flagged_not_a_publication rather than deleted, so you can strip them in one pass once you agree. 0 dependency edges in this file touch one.
